The program is written and builds with `build.sh`. `node check.mjs` passes all 5 example cases. A test run of 1,000,000 commands with capacity 1,000,000 took about 0.5s, and input whose last line has no trailing newline works too.

- **Files:** the cache is in `lru.go`, input handling is in `main.go`, and `build.sh` builds a stripped release binary at `./app`.
- **Design:** a map from key to slot in a single node array, with a doubly linked recency list, so every command runs in O(1) expec
